brief:
Israeli authorities are tightening control over Palestinian schools in East Jerusalem through restrictions on teaching staff and pressure to adopt Israeli curricula, Al Jazeera English reported. The measures target educators and instruction in schools serving the Palestinian population of the occupied territory.

The restrictions threaten the continuity of Palestinian education in the city, where schools face mounting pressure to align with Israeli educational standards. Teachers operate under Israeli constraints while authorities push for curriculum changes that would alter the character of Palestinian schooling in East Jerusalem.
dek: Israeli restrictions on teachers and pressure to adopt Israeli curriculum threaten Palestinian education in the city.
title: Israel restricts Palestinian teachers, pressures East Jerusalem schools on curriculum
